intro: Humbert's Sword is the personal sidearm belonging to Deathguard Humbert of Tarren Mill. The weapon was looted from his camp by dwarven soldiers while he was scouting their stronghold at Dun Garok.

p: Deathguard Humbert was dispatched by High Executor Darthalia to monitor the dwarven presence at Dun Garok from a concealed position. While he left his post unattended one morning to collect firewood to boil water, dwarven patrols stumbled across his campsite and plundered all of his gear, including his personal blade. With so many dwarves to search, Humbert relies on Horde agents to infiltrate the fortress and retrieve his lost weapon.

Following the theft, Humbert's belongings were carried back behind the fortified barricades of Dun Garok. Because dwarven riflemen, mountaineers, and priests circulate supplies throughout the garrison, locating the specific thief requires searching among the defenders stationed within the stronghold's trenches and redoubts.
